No finite-horizon extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: The source explicitly poses classification of alternative periodic memory patterns. The complete first four nontrivial periods, with the earliest non-rotation family appearing at period five, is a natural mathematically motivated boundary and directly explains why the naive rigidity conjecture fails. Exact finite classification, explicit infinite noncyclic recurrence and a reusable finite-decision lemma provide concrete structural content rather than routine sample computation.
